detection_evidence: No paradigm is declared ('a simulation model'). DES vocabulary: 'individual patients flow through triage, assessment and treatment', 'entities with attributes', 'activities', 'resources are 6 nurses and 3 doctors', 'queue for triage', 'arrival profile'. SD vocabulary: 'continuously accumulating level of staff fatigue', 'one level ... with an inflow ... and an outflow', 'reinforcing loop', 'No graphical (lookup) functions are used'. The two parts are explicitly coupled (section 4, last paragraph), so a hybrid DES+SD audit is expected after a SOFT pause (or, when the user says 'just do it', with header basis 'inferred, user said proceed').

hybrid_interface_check.evidence: Section 4, last paragraph: 'The two parts are coupled in both directions: every simulated hour the current value of the fatigue level is read and converted into a treatment-time multiplier ... in the other direction, the number of patients in treatment at the end of each hour is passed to the fatigue accumulation inflow.'

from_supplement.evidence: Supplement S1 table of all base-case parameters with distributions, plus the distribution-selection sentence
Supplement S2: stochastic, 30 replications, justification by CI half-width
Supplement S2 states the common-random-number stream allocation (second sentence of DES-supp 5.2) but no document names the random-number algorithm (first sentence)

deliberate_gaps.derivation: Section 4 mentions 'A bespoke triage priority algorithm assigns each patient to one of the five categories' but gives no detail, pseudo-code or reference to other published work.

DES side: entities, activities, resources and entry/exit are described; no queue discipline is stated anywhere. SD side: the level is named with units and its inflow/outflow; flow equations are absent (only verbal 'rises with', 'proportional to'); constants appear only as values in the supplement, not as equations with units in the model description; sources/sinks are not described.

The main text mentions 'last year's attendances' only in passing and the supplement gives n = 61,400 attendances for the fit, but neither names the data source, its date range nor other sources; graders may accept Partially addressed if they credit the supplement's n = 61,400.
No statement on data manipulation anywhere.

Nothing on terminating/non-terminating, warm-up, initial queue contents (DES 4.1); the supplement's 'Initial fatigue 0' is a single parameter value, not an initialisation statement for the SD side listing initial values of stocks and auxiliaries; graders may accept Partially addressed if they credit that row.
Section 6: 'AnyLogic 8.8 (Personal Learning Edition)' but no operating system, version or build number.
No event-processing mechanism, no integration method or DT for the fatigue level.

justified_not_applicable.evidence: Section 3: 'The model has so far been run only for the base case; no scenario experiments have been conducted.'
